parts.title: Task 1
parts.passage_text:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The line chart below shows the percentage of people in different age groups who played video games more than ten hours a week between 1984 and 2003.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Task 2
parts.passage_text: Some people argue that teaching children of different abilities together benefits all of them. Others believe that intelligent children should be taught separately and given special treatment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
